name: mattbriggs/baselinter
description: Base Linter is a command-line interface app checks for sets of words in a text by order. Each time the app encounters a word belonging to a set, it prompts you to choose which of the words in the set. The app will replace the word in that position in the word order in the text you are checking. When you are done, the app saved the updated text as a file with the date in the filename.
